title: Close two cardinality display and retry gaps
objective: A transaction with several loads shows carrier names and a date span on its single sales-dashboard row, and a scale-ticket cron failure is retried on the next run. Competing ownership keeps exactly one committed parent. The seven baseline test failures stay untouched.
success_criteria: A transaction with three loads still produces one plasticos.sales.dashboard row whose revenue_total and gross_margin equal the transaction, while carrier_name lists each distinct carrier and pickup_datetime is the earliest pickup
After one load's scale-ticket reminder raises, the next cron run records that load's reminder without waiting for the scan cursor to wrap
Two concurrent parent assignments still leave one committed parent and one rolled-back session
The seven baseline failures remain the same tests and are not edited

in: plasticos_commission sales dashboard SQL view and its cardinality test
plasticos_documents scale-ticket cron retry list and its cardinality test
The existing competing-ownership test contract for SerializationFailure
out: Changing PostgreSQL isolation or retrying a SerializationFailure inside the request

todos.task: Fill carrier_name and the date columns from per-transaction aggregates when a deal has several loads. Keep one dashboard row and do not sum money.
Store scale-ticket load ids whose savepoint failed and process that list at the start of the next cron run while the scan cursor still advances.
State in the competing-ownership test that SerializationFailure is a full rollback of the loser under repeatable read. Do not change the lock or the isolation level.
Leave the seven baseline failures unchanged.
todos.blocker: The same seven assertions fail on isolated origin/Staging at 677d734. Repair belongs on a separate branch.

milestones.outcome: Dashboard cardinality test shows one financial row plus aggregated carrier and pickup
A failed scale-ticket load is present in the retry parameter and succeeds on the following run

checkpoints.evidence_required: The cardinality test asserts len(rows)==1, equal revenue, a combined carrier_name, and the earliest pickup
checkpoints.no_go_action: Revert the view change if the search returns more than one row or the money differs from the transaction

checkpoints.evidence_required: test_one_load_failure_does_not_stop_the_next_load shows the failed id in the retry parameter and a later run sets the reminder
checkpoints.no_go_action: Revert the retry list if the cursor stops advancing or a failure blocks the rest of the page

doc_root_surface_impact.reason: No command, module count, or CI contract change

disconfirming_questions: Does string_agg of carrier names duplicate revenue_total when three loads exist?
Does a permanently failing load stop the scan cursor?
Does accepting SerializationFailure hide a second committed parent?
assumed_false_ifs: The dashboard join fans out to one financial row per load
The retry list replaces the cursor and strands loads above the cursor
The seven baseline failures were introduced by the cardinality commits
stress_test.blast_radius: plasticos_commission view rebuild and plasticos_documents cron state in ir.config_parameter. No schema drop. No accounting formula change.
stress_test.rollback: Revert the two module commits. The view rebuilds from the previous init SQL on the next module update. The retry parameter is unused if the cron code is reverted.

shared_causes: Singular load columns were nulled for every multi-load deal to protect financial cardinality
The scale-ticket cursor advances before each load's savepoint commits
deletions_or_consolidations: Do not add a second dashboard row model
Do not change database isolation to turn SerializationFailure into ValidationError

risks.risk: Aggregated carrier text is mistaken for one carrier
risks.mitigation: Distinct names are comma-separated and load_id stays empty when the count is not 1, so the open-load action still refuses a single load

risks.risk: A load that fails on every run grows the retry parameter without bound
risks.mitigation: The stored id list is capped at the existing batch size of 300

unknowns.question: Who repairs the seven baseline failures?
unknowns.decision_effect: They are excluded from this branch. A later branch can take them.
